chunks: Do you see any trace of them?

key_terms.بَاقِيَةٍ: a remaining portion, trace, or remnant

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'baqiyyah' refer to in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question from Surah Al-Haqqa (69:29) underscores the totality of divine retribution against the disbelievers, often linked to the fate of specific factions like the Khawarij or early opponents of the Ahl al-Bayt. It highlights the concept of 'Baqa' (remaining), emphasizing that no trace or remnant of their power or existence will endure after God's decisive judgment.
